name: athlete-space
description: Builds training plans for a goal race, from 5K to marathon, and training seasons for triathlon, HYROX, cycling, CrossFit, swimming, and running with strength.

interface.longDescription: Athlete Space builds a full training plan inside the chat. For a goal race from 5K to marathon it writes every week and every run, sets training paces from a recent race or your easy pace, and predicts your race times. If you miss sessions, it rebuilds the plan around them. For triathlon (sprint to Ironman), HYROX, cycling, CrossFit, swimming, and running with strength, it builds a season: phases, hours for each week, and the sessions of the first weeks and the peak week, sized to the hours you have. No account is needed and nothing is saved. Each plan comes with a link that opens the same plan on athletespace.ai, where you can save it and sync it to your watch.
defaultPrompt: Build me a half marathon plan. I run 20 miles a week, 4 days.
Build a HYROX season for 6 hours a week over 5 days.
I missed two runs this week. Rebuild my plan.

positive.description: Builds a running plan from a goal race, weekly distance and easy pace.
positive.prompt: Build me a half marathon plan for a race on 2027-06-13. I run 20 miles a week, 4 days a week, and my easy pace is 9:30 per mile.
positive.expected_behavior: A plan card shows the half marathon, the race date, predicted race times, training paces in minutes per mile, and every week with its runs. A link opens the same plan on athletespace.ai.

positive.description: Uses a recent race result for paces and works in kilometres.
positive.prompt: I want a marathon plan for 2027-10-17. I run 50 km a week over 5 days and ran a 10K in 48:30 last month. Use kilometres.
positive.expected_behavior: A marathon plan card in kilometres, with paces and predicted times derived from the 48:30 10K, and every week with its runs.

positive.description: Rebuilds a running plan around sessions the athlete missed.
positive.prompt: I'm on a 10K plan for a race on 2027-05-16. I run 15 miles a week, 4 days, easy pace 10:00 per mile. I missed both runs in week 2 that fell on Tuesday and Thursday. Rebuild the plan.
positive.expected_behavior: The plan is built first to find the dates of the week 2 Tuesday and Thursday runs, then rebuilt. The new plan card keeps the same race and date and adjusts the weeks after the missed runs.

positive.description: Builds a multi-sport season for a triathlon with a race date.
positive.prompt: Build a 70.3 triathlon season for a race on 2027-08-22. I train regularly, about 9 hours a week over 6 days.
positive.expected_behavior: A season card shows the phases, the hours for each week, and the swim, bike and run sessions of the first weeks and the peak week, sized to about 9 hours.

positive.description: Builds a season for a sport with no race date.
positive.prompt: I'm new to HYROX. Build me a season for 5 hours a week over 4 days.
positive.expected_behavior: A HYROX season card at beginner level shows phases, weekly hours, and the sessions of the first weeks and the peak week, sized to about 5 hours.

negative.description: Unrelated request. No tool applies, so the plugin should not be called.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Boston this weekend?

negative.description: The plugin has no account access and cannot log or read workouts. It should not be called, and ChatGPT should say it cannot do this.
negative.prompt: Log my 5 mile run from this morning to my Athlete Space account.

negative.description: Medical question. The plugin builds plans only and should not be called. ChatGPT should point to a doctor.
negative.prompt: I get sharp chest pain when I run. What medication should I take?

publication.release_notes: The season tool now takes a cycling FTP, a swim pace and a triathlete's weakest discipline, and shows watt and split targets. All three tools take the athlete's language and return the plan in English, Spanish, French, German, Italian or Portuguese.
